_comment_admin_uuids: Array of highly privileged UUIDs that completely bypass all quota limits and concurrent session tracking constraints.
_comment_max_sessions_per_uuid: Default fallback threshold for maximum concurrent active sockets allowed per non-admin commercial user to prevent multi-device subscription sharing.
_comment_admin_api_addr: Strict localhost interface and port binding for secure inter-process backend accounting dashboard controls.
_comment_upstream_proxy: Optional: set to socks5://127.0.0.1:40000 only after installing and connecting Cloudflare WARP or another local SOCKS5 proxy on the VPS. Leave empty otherwise.
_comment_compression_entropy_threshold: Threshold boundary (default 224) to bypass Zstd response encoding on downstream bulk data streams if entropy analysis detects pre-encrypted payloads.
_comment_max_sessions: Hard ceiling for active concurrent upstream TCP sockets to prevent kernel resource exhaustion loops.
